title: Normalized tensor and scalar chain models for point evaluation
statement: For an algebraically closed field k, final-object evaluation on commutative ring sheaves has normalized TensorModel data, satisfying TensorCoherent and the degree-zero identity unit formula. For every coefficient morphism its canonical extension of scalars has ScalarModel data satisfying ScalarCoherent. These are the ordinary ambient cochain tensors and their specified pure-tensor and total-summand formulas; no coefficient flatness is assumed. Uses [def-sf-point-evaluation-tensor-data], [def-sf-point-evaluation-scalar-data] and their coherence predicates. This asserts only chain models, not the geometric point identification, derived comparison uniqueness, or completed coefficient sections.

proof.text: Evaluation of sheafification at the final object is bijective since every covering sieve contains its identity. Use its inverse to identify the sheaf tensor with the tensor of evaluated modules. The right-adjoint lax monoidal structure is consequently strong monoidal, with identity unit. Extend this structure to direct-sum cochain totalization; the summand map is the evaluated section tensor. Associativity and unitors are standard total constraints and symmetry has the same Koszul sign on both sides. Apply the ringed-point stalk criterion for K-flatness and flatness of module inverse image. Evaluate sheafified scalar extension to identify it with ordinary scalar extension. On pure generators its tensor square is the balanced multiplication formula; extend by tensor linearity and coproduct extensionality. Scalar extension preserves flat-term K-flat complexes by ringed pullback.

theorem point_evaluation_chain_models (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] :
    ∃ T : ∀ B : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (Spec (.of k))) CommRingCat.{u + 1},
        TensorModel B,
      (∀ B, TensorCoherent B (T B) ∧
        ∀ [(pointModuleSections k B).PreservesZeroMorphisms],
          HEq (T B).unit
            ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex (W₁ := ModuleSheaves B)
              (W₂ := ModuleCat.{u + 1} (sectionRing k B)) (pointModuleSections k B)
              (.up ℤ) 0).app
              (SheafOfModules.unit.{u, u + 1, u + 1}
                ((sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology (Spec (.of k)))
                  (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj B)) ≪≫
              (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (sectionRing k B))
                (.up ℤ) 0).mapIso (T B).moduleUnit)) ∧
      ∀ (B B' : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (Spec (.of k))) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
        (a : B ⟶ B'), ∃ S : ScalarModel a (T B) (T B'), ScalarCoherent a (T B) (T B') S
